title: Correlate concurrent reference-publication diagnostic lines with the failing request
outcome: Allow diagnostic stages from two same-key contenders and the existing one typed503 replay to be attributed to their own operation, without influencing authority, production behavior or retry policy.
acceptance: Test-only diagnostic lines carry stable request/operation correlation across the relevant asynchronous and blocking boundaries; a thread id alone is not claimed sufficient if execution migrates.
A deterministic concurrent test associates failure stage/error lines with the correct contender/replay, without weakening the existing201/descriptor/marker assertions or adding retries/timeouts.
The exact-input independent review pair and maintained full gate satisfy repository landing policy.
